description: USD price of any token on Base by contract address, read live from the deepest Uniswap v3 pool (against USDC or WETH): price, pool, fee tier, liquidity and the other pools quoted for comparison (token=0x...). For trading, portfolio and risk agents that need a price without a data-vendor key. Pay per call $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

token.description: ERC-20 token address on Base, e.g. 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006 (WETH); if omitted, the WETH example is answered

x_payment.description: signed x402 payment (X-PAYMENT header value); omit on the first call to receive the price and payment requirements
